commands.name: refresh
commands.description: Touch logged-in site sessions to keep browser auth fresh

command_options.name: site
command_options.help: Comma-separated site names to refresh, e.g. github,claude

command_options.name: all
command_options.help: Ignore the 24h refresh throttle and force every selected site

command_options.name: concurrency
command_options.help: Maximum sites to refresh at once

command_options.name: format
command_options.help: Output format: table, plain, json, yaml, md, csv

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show login status for sites with auth adapters

command_options.name: site
command_options.help: Comma-separated site names to check, e.g. github,chatgpt

command_options.name: full
command_options.help: Run full per-site whoami probes instead of quick no-navigation checks

command_options.name: concurrency
command_options.help: Maximum sites to check at once

command_options.name: format
command_options.help: Output format: table, plain, json, yaml, md, csv

global_options.name: profile
global_options.help: Chrome profile/context alias for Browser Bridge commands
